function.description: Creates a new instance of a searchable snapshot directory for a shard in a repository with the provided settings and services. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

repositories.description: The service that provides access to the repositories. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

cache.description: The cache service. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

indexSettings.description: The settings for the index that the shard belongs to. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

shardPath.description: The path to the shard data. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

currentTimeNanosSupplier.description: A supplier that provides the current time in nanoseconds. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

threadPool.description: The thread pool for executing tasks. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

blobStoreCacheService.description: The service for caching blobs. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

sharedBlobCacheService.description: The service for caching blobs shared across multiple shards. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
